sentences.text:
on 7 April, 2025
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.10422 of 2025
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1, 3 to 5, learned Government Pleader for MA&UD appearing for respondent No.2, learned standing counsel for Central Government appearing for respondent No.6,
Sri.K.R.Koteshwar Rao, learned standing counsel for cantonment Board appearing for respondent No.7 and V.Narshimha Goud, learned standing counsel for HMDA appearing for respondent No.8.
With their consent, the writ petition is taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. This writ petition has been filed seeking the following prayer:-
"to declare the Preliminary Notification Vide B2/36/2024 DT.13-12- 2024 and several other Preliminary Notification vide separate File Numbers published in The Hyderabad District Gazette Nos.MMD- 10 to MMD-17 dt 19-11-2024, issued under Section 11(1) of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 herein after called the Act No.30 of 2013, without including my property and other properties situated at Devton Bazar on the ground that the properties come under the category of B-3 Lands, is arbitrary illegal and against the Principal of Natural Justice and consequently direct the Respondents to acquire my land by following due process of law as laid down under The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013."

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Though various grounds are raised in the writ petition, learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to respondent No.7 to dispose the petitioner's representation dated 06.02.2025, in a time bound period.
4. Learned standing counsel appearing for respondent No.7 did not dispute the same.

5. In view of the submission made by learned counsel on either side and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent No.7 to dispose the petitioner's representation dated 06.02.2025 and pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six (06) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and communicate the same to the petitioner.
6. Accordingly this writ petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
